 Order

1. The petitioners are before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:
a) Call for the records in respect of order dated 24.10.2016 passed in CC No.23759/2016 by the 4th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore,
taking cognizance for the offences punishable under Section 120(B), 406, 420 IPC and Section 9 of Investors Protection Act and consequently issuing NBW against the petitioners.

b) Quash the Charge sheet dated 01.05.2016 in Crime No.210/2015 in C.C.No.23759/2016 filed before the 4th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore and consequently, the order dated 24.10.2016 passed in C.C.No.23759/2016 by the 4th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore at Annexure - A and B respectively and further proceedings pursuant thereto,
and NC: 2024:KHC:15133 c) Grant such other relief/s as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in the circumstances of the case, in the interest of justice and equity.
